description: This file defines the 'MailMerge' class, which provides functionality to perform mail merge operations within the SuiteCRM platform. It handles template processing, data source creation, header file generation, and managing Word document interactions through COM objects.

classes.name: MailMerge
classes.description: A class that manages mail merge operations, including template handling, data source creation, and document generation using Microsoft Word automation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize mail merge with optional list, field list, and data directory.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs the mail merge process if data is available, returning the generated document filename.

methods.name: Template
methods.description: Sets the template for the mail merge if provided as an array.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Removes temporary files and directories created during the mail merge process.

methods.name: CreateHeaderFile
methods.description: Generates a header file in the Word document with the field list.

methods.name: CreateDataSource
methods.description: Creates a data source document containing the list of data entries.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: Opens a template document, performs the mail merge by linking header and data sources, saves the result, and closes the document.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the COM Word application object and sets up the temporary directories.

methods.name: SetDataList
methods.description: Updates the data list used for mail merge.

methods.name: SetFieldList
methods.description: Updates the field list used for header creation.
